scope: First deterministic EPIC Ego bottle action-control render
summary: The controls encoded explicit separated trajectories, but a static clean-plate reconstruction removed the source head-camera dynamics and visibly damaged the kitchen scene.
evidence: All three control videos decoded and reached the declared terminal holders.
Contact-sheet review showed scene destruction and loss of the original Ego camera motion.
lessons: An Ego control must preserve the per-frame source background and camera motion; a single static clean plate is not an acceptable conditioning canvas.
limitations: The rendered controls are unsuitable for formal H3 generation despite valid state traces.
next_actions: Render on the moving source frames and restrict cleanup to the human-hand support.
